notes.title: Orion13 Release Anniversary
notes.content:
[h3]We're celebrating the anniversary of Orion13's steam launch with a big Steam Sale until February 15th![/h3]
Our Arena Leaderboard is cross-platform and ready to be conquered! Come join the celebration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35843279/2c9a2dcb9e01fec6f0ade140cbc5619e68db7330.gif[/img]

We want to take a moment to sincerely thank everyone that has tried our game, shared it, reviewed it, given valuable feedback, and helped us along the way. 

We are continuing to make improvements and have exciting projects in our pipeline that we can't wait to share with you when the time comes.

notes.title: Orion13 now supports Oculus, Vive, Index, and WMR
notes.content:
[h1]Orion13 now supports Oculus, Vive, Index, and WMR[/h1]

In addition to this major update, we have added improved head tracking, head steering, seated and standing play modes, better graphics, greater performance, and more!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35843279/2c7a3005d9e85f475689277cc06949e00d363471.gif[/img]

notes.title: Orion13 MEGA update - June 25th.
notes.content:
We are releasing our biggest update ever for Orion13 on June 25th. This update includes:

[list]
[*] Full support for Oculus, Vive, Index, and WMR headsets and controllers
[*] Improved graphics, and including a "low graphics" mode for compatibility with old graphics cards
[*] Improved performance!
[*] Improved gameplay
[*] Online leaderboard challenge arena
[/list]

notes.title: Orion13 v1.1
notes.content:
This update has quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes and is available now for download.

[list]
[*]Major performance improvements
[*]Improvements to AI animation
[*]Slightly improved combat system
[*]A compatibility fix for older AMD cards
[*]Improved lighting
[/list]

As outlined in our community roadmap in our Steam discussion forum, we have features to include in our next major patch and will continue to add improvements and fix bugs as they come in. Please [url=https://discord.gg/YbKRtnV]contact us on our Discord[/url] with any bugs, questions, or feedback.

notes.title: Orion13 Release Date
notes.content:
[b]Orion13[/b], the next-gen VR hack & slash adventure will release on [u]February 13th, 2020[/u] with support for the Oculus Rift, Rift S, and Quest via link cable.

[h3]Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Open locomotion with no restrictions or training wheels!
[*] Fast-paced combat that doesn't tie you down
[*] Full in-game body with first person inverse kinematics
[*] Interactive inventory
[*] Complete story to add to the adventure
[*] Interactive puzzles
[*] Survival Arena with online leaderboard
[*] Original soundtrack
[/list]
